Portable 5.04 kWh LiFePO4 power station for home backup and off-grid use. 4800 W continuous output, 8-year warranty, EU Battery Regulation compliant.

Specifications
- Capacity: 5.04 kWh
- Chemistry: Lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4)
- Nominal voltage: 48 V
- Continuous output: 4800 W
- Expected lifetime: 4500 cycles
- Weight: 45.9 kg
- Warranty: 8 years

Compliance
EU Battery Regulation compliant.
